purpose: Replace part of Coin financing-risk admission/reduction; not a price forecast or holding-cost timer.
hypothesis: Actual isolated collateral depleted by mark moves/funding can expose owned positions to financing-tail loss; a persistent campaign cap may reduce that loss more efficiently than uniform risk reduction.
funding_stress: Three settlements at the largest nonnegative directional payer rate from last three consecutive already-settled native receipts; scenario, never a forecast or a guaranteed future charge. This expression assumes the verified native eight-hour UTC settlement interval; a changed interval is unsupported, not silently normalised.
required_inputs: fresh wholly owned signed BTCUSDT isolated position
actual isolated wallet, entry, mark/PnL and native liquidation price
owned full-position protection and no pending/remainders
last three consecutive completed native funding settlements
independently justified native remaining-margin lower bound for half reduction
persistent_cap: Absolute owned BTC ceiling from first breach, same account/campaign/direction, external checkpoint persisted before execution; only owned flat confirmation at or after saved last_observed_ms and no later than actual account observed_ms may release it. Later receipt availability cannot legitimise an old flat observation.
half_guard: Pro-rata collateral release does not improve liquidation buffer ratio; half may emit only a research proposal with a separately justified remaining-isolated-wallet lower bound AFTER settled reduction fees and realised PnL, covering stress at the actual remaining entry (no assumed entry reset). Missing bound waits, inadequate bound rejects expression.
support_before_wallet: Actual causal actionable breach plus qualified native funding/mark/margin/brackets and a lawful owned reduction; no threshold widening to force events.
account_comparison: Same funds, costs, FX, schedule and cold start; no curve scaling, no spot collateral or transfers. Report actual fees/funding, tail loss, recovery, upside/downside beta and return cost.
adoption: Current benefit-harm policy; return deterioration is not sole veto. Demonstrable material financing-tail benefit versus simple-risk control is required. No default change/native qualification from pure proposals.

historical_support.reason: SessionExchange current historical adapter supplies a fixed synthetic one-tier bracket and proxy allocated margin/liquidation, explicitly not contemporaneous dated native bracket evidence. Existing wallet/market paths cannot manufacture it.

failure_routes: Half without supported retained-collateral benefit stays pending or negative; never describe pro-rata reduction as liquidation safety.
One alternative full flatten expression only when qualified actual financing breach exists; still compare opportunity cost to simple risk reduction.
Both economic expressions fail: retain negatives and replace risk information source; do not tune shock or funding threshold repeatedly.
